snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Enforcer
snippet.description:
Introducing the Enforcer!

A guardian imbued with divine power, the Enforcer excels in engaging multiple enemies at once, as well as blocking front line attacks. It uses debuffs and Taunt skills to neutralize enemy tactics and effectively protects allies with its shield.

Protect allies with an impenetrable Force barrier and deliver the inescapable judgement of Light upon enemies—experience the Enforcer biosuit's combat capabilities today!
